lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 to 11 high-contrast white vertical lines are visible. Spacing is relatively equidistant across the anterior and mid-sections, with lines becoming more fragmented and widely spaced toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 8th, 9th, and 10th vertical segments (counting from anterior to posterior) are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the lower half of the torso mass, with the final segments appearing as elongated dashes.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5-6 white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch, located posterior to the final vertical line segment.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-posterior haunch align horizontally, forming a short geometric line relative to the horizontal axis of the body.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct white marking present on the bridge of the muzzle and a singular white spot on the lower cheek. High-contrast white 'socks' are visible on the lower distal segments of all four limbs, extending from the hooves to the mid-metacarpal/metatarsal regions.
